title: Pasado — contá una vida
goals: Meta declarada por el material: describir hechos pasados y escribir la biografía de alguien.
Decí las fechas en voz alta, uní los hechos con conectores y manejá el past simple de regulares e irregulares.
Cerrá contando una vida entera en cien palabras.

source.note: El -ed tiene tres pronunciaciones y solo una agrega sílaba. Es LA trampa del pasado regular.

atoms.prompt: Completá con WAS o WERE.

items.stem: Peter and David ___ very sleepy last night.

source.section: Learning new vocabulary — Connectors

atoms.prompt: Uní las dos oraciones con AND, BUT, BECAUSE o SO.

items.stem: John took a bath early in the morning ___ he had to go to the doctor.
The family had dinner very quickly ___ they wanted to go to the museum.
Bella took off her slippers ___ she went to bed afterwards.
Ben lost the boxing challenge ___ he didn't care.
Greg put a reminder on his finger ___ he did not forget the meeting.
George got an A plus at English ___ he felt really happy.

blanks.note: La grilla publica AND/SO: las dos son correctas.

source.note: Narrativa nuestra sobre García Lorca, a partir de las notas que da el material para la producción final (pág. 21).

atoms.narrative: Federico García Lorca was a Spanish writer and poet. He was born in Fuente Vaqueros, near Granada, on the fifth of June, eighteen ninety-eight. He studied at the University of Granada from nineteen fourteen. In nineteen twenty-eight he wrote Romancero Gitano, and the book made him famous. A year later he visited New York, and the city changed his poetry. Back in Spain he wrote Bodas de Sangre, one of his most famous plays. He died near Granada on the nineteenth of August, nineteen thirty-six. He was only thirty-eight years old.
atoms.speaker: narrator

questions.q: How old was he when he died?

source.note: Consigna textual del material, con las notas de García Lorca que da la propia página. El modelo y los pasos son nuestros.

atoms.prompt: Write a biography (about 100 words). Include birth, job, education, career and death.
atoms.modelAnswer: Federico García Lorca was a Spanish writer and poet. He was born in Fuente Vaqueros, near Granada, on the fifth of June, eighteen ninety-eight. He studied at the University of Granada from nineteen fourteen. In nineteen twenty-eight he wrote Romancero Gitano, and the book made him famous all over Spain. A few years later he visited New York, and the city changed his poetry. When he returned, he wrote Bodas de Sangre, one of his most famous plays. He died near Granada on the nineteenth of August, nineteen thirty-six. He was only thirty-eight years old.
modelVariants: William Shakespeare was the greatest writer in the English language. He was born in Stratford-upon-Avon in fifteen sixty-four. At the age of eighteen he married Anne Hathaway, who was eight years older than himself. A few years later he moved to London, where he worked as an actor and playwright. He wrote thirty-seven plays and one hundred and fifty-four sonnets. His most famous plays are the four great tragedies. He died in Stratford-upon-Avon on the twenty-third of April, sixteen sixteen, but his plays are still popular today.
scaffold: 1. Quién fue: nombre + qué hacía (was a Spanish writer and poet).
2. Nacimiento: dónde y cuándo (was born in… on…).
3. Educación: dónde estudió y desde cuándo.
4. La obra que lo hizo conocido, con su año.
5. Un giro en la carrera (un viaje, una mudanza).
6. Muerte: dónde, cuándo y con qué edad.

rubric.text: Abrís diciendo quién fue y a qué se dedicaba
Cerrás con la muerte y la edad
Decís los años en voz alta (nineteen twenty-eight, no 1928)

source.section: Presentación de la unidad
source.note: La meta declarada incluye contar los hechos pasados de la propia vida; la consigna y el modelo son nuestros.

atoms.prompt: Tell the story of your own life: birth, school, studies and one important moment.
atoms.modelAnswer: I was born in Buenos Aires in nineteen ninety-eight. When I was a child, my family lived in a small flat near the river, and I went to a public school two blocks away. I was not a very good student at first, but in secondary school I discovered mathematics and everything changed. At the age of eighteen I started the Licenciatura en Matemática at the UAI. The first year was hard because I worked in the morning and studied at night. A few years later I began to enjoy it, and now I am still here, learning English so I can read papers in my field.
scaffold: 1. Nacimiento: dónde y cuándo (I was born in… in…).
2. La infancia: dónde vivías, a qué escuela ibas.
3. Un contraste: cómo eras antes y qué cambió.
4. El estudio: qué empezaste y a qué edad.
5. Una dificultad concreta, con because.
6. El presente: dónde estás ahora y para qué.

rubric.text: Usás was/were para los estados del pasado
Usás un conector para explicar (because, but, so)
Decís los años en palabras, no en cifras

source.note: Versión oral de la biografía que el material da por escrito. El modelo y los pasos son nuestros.

atoms.prompt: Tell the story of Frida Kahlo in your own words, without reading.
atoms.modelAnswer: Frida Kahlo was a Mexican painter. She was born in Mexico City in nineteen oh seven, and she painted many self-portraits and paintings of Mexican folklore. In nineteen twenty-two she went to the Escuela Preparatoria, a prestigious school where at that time there were not many girls. Three years later, at the age of eighteen, she had a terrible traffic accident. She could not walk for a long time, so she started painting. In nineteen twenty-nine she married the painter Diego Rivera. They moved to New York, but she was not happy there and they returned to Mexico. She won a national art prize in nineteen forty-six and became famous. She died in nineteen fifty-four, when she was only forty-seven.
scaffold: 1. Quién fue y de dónde.
2. Qué pintaba.
3. La escuela, con el dato de que había pocas chicas.
4. El accidente, y cómo la llevó a pintar (so).
5. Diego Rivera y Nueva York, con el contraste (but).
6. El premio, la fama y la muerte.

rubric.text: Conectás el accidente con la pintura usando so
Usás but para el contraste de Nueva York
Cerrás con la muerte y la edad

source.note: Consigna nuestra: el pasado de la vida cotidiana, que la unidad entrena solo en registro de biografía.

atoms.prompt: Tell what you did last weekend, from Friday evening to Sunday night.
atoms.modelAnswer: On Friday evening I finished work late, so I did not go out. I stayed at home and watched a film with my sister. On Saturday morning I got up early and went to the market, because we needed vegetables for the week. In the afternoon a friend came to visit and we talked for hours. On Sunday I studied for this exam. I read the whole unit twice, but I did not remember everything, so I made a summary. At night I cooked pasta and went to bed early. It was a quiet weekend, but I needed it.
scaffold: 1. El viernes a la noche, con el porqué (so / because).
2. El sábado a la mañana.
3. El sábado a la tarde.
4. El domingo: lo que estudiaste.
5. Algo que NO hiciste (negativa).
6. El cierre con una valoración.

rubric.text: Cerrás con una valoración del fin de semana

steps.hint: Cerrá con was + una valoración: le da un final, no un corte.

atoms.title: William Shakespeare

blocks.text: William Shakespeare was the greatest writer in the English language. He was born in 1564 in Stratford-upon-Avon, a small town in the centre of England.
At the age of eighteen he married Anne Hathaway, who was eight years older than himself. They had three children. A few years later he moved to London, where he worked as an actor and a playwright.
He wrote thirty-seven plays and one hundred and fifty-four sonnets. His most famous plays are the four great tragedies: Hamlet, Macbeth, King Lear and Othello.
Shakespeare died in Stratford-upon-Avon on the twenty-third of April, 1616, but his plays are still performed all over the world today.
